lines: Good evening. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
‘Are u really threatening to play China off the U.S.?’ Trump trade adviser asks PM Carney, CP24 reports.
Gordie Howe International Bridge becomes most popular border crossing between Michigan and Ontario in October, The Canadian Press reports.
The U.S. stock market shook again Tuesday as Nvidia and other jittery stocks in the artificial-intelligence industry led widespread losses on Wall Street, The Canadian Press reports.
Duffy pitches Senate GOP on $50 billion for FAA after ground stop, CBS News reports.
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s party has repeatedly claimed the vote was ‘stolen’ by Arab-led parties, possibly with foreign assistance, The Associated Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
